name: com.alimm.tanx.core.ad.ad.template.rendering.reward.RewardPortraitActivity
description: Tanx Core SDK opens this portrait rewarded-ad screen to display ad content and a reward countdown. When the required viewing period ends, it reports the reward to the app.
disableEffect: The Tanx rewarded-ad screen will not open, so rewards for watching ads will no longer be granted.
